name: Box watch (restart a dark box; hourly Orgo lever check)

knobs.note: BH-10231: failed ssh probes in a row (one per 5-min tick) before bin/box-watch.sh restarts a box. the settings row box_watch.fail_probes wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.

BH-10231: at most one restart per box in this many minutes (local stamp, then the D1 claim, which reads the same settings row). the settings row box_watch.restart_window_min wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.
BH-10231: seconds each `ssh root@<ip> true` probe may take. the settings row box_watch.probe_timeout_s wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.

BH-10231: this many dark boxes in one tick = the hub's own network; restart none, one warn alert. the settings row box_watch.mass_dark_boxes wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.
BH-10231: seconds the act waits for ssh after the restart. the settings row box_watch.boot_wait_s wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.
BH-10231: seconds between probes in the boot wait. the settings row box_watch.boot_poll_s wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.
BH-10231: seconds the one recovery ssh may take. the settings row box_watch.recovery_timeout_s wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.

BH-10231: seconds one act (claim, restart, boot wait, recovery, re-probe) may take; a timeout pages. the settings row box_watch.act_timeout_s wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.
BH-10231: curl -m seconds of the hourly GET /workspaces lever check. the settings row box_watch.orgo_timeout_s wins over this env; out of range = the fallback plus one WARN log line.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: the ssh command each probe and the recovery run before root@<ip>. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: the restart command, default $HARNESS/bin/box-ops.sh. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: this box's name, default bin/box-name.sh; never probed. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: 1 runs act inline in the tick, not detached. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: the clock (epoch seconds) of the restart window. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: the boot wait in seconds. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-watch.sh: the act timeout in seconds. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
